🎓 How to Use the Competitive Analysis Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate deal-specific CI briefs in seconds.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "CI brief for [account]"
  • "Competitive intel on [deal]"
  • "How to beat [competitor]"
  • "Deal coaching vs Oracle"
  • "Sales brief for [opportunity]"
📝

Sample Prompt

"Create a CI brief for my deal with Acme Corp. They're in manufacturing, evaluating SAP S/4HANA vs Oracle Cloud. Deal size is $2M, currently in evaluation stage. Main concerns are implementation timeline and TCO."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Deal-Specific Intel — Tailored to industry & stage
  • Talk Tracks — Ready-to-use messaging
  • Landmine Questions — Expose competitor weakness
  • Objection Handlers — Counter their strongest pitch
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include objections — "They said we're too expensive"
  • Add deal stage — Messaging changes by stage
  • Mention champion — "My contact is the CFO"
  • Ask for references — "Similar wins in manufacturing"
